title: Webb County Sheriff's Office Serves About 600 Plates at Thanksgiving Luncheon
excerpt: The Webb County Sheriff's Office gathered for a Thanksgiving luncheon Tuesday, Nov. 24, with Sheriff Martin Cuellar and his wife Donna Cuellar handing out about 600 plates to county employees, elected officials, local veterans, and friends of the office.
content:
The Webb County Sheriff's Office gathered for a Thanksgiving luncheon on Tuesday, Nov. 24, sharing a meal and giving thanks with county employees, elected officials, local veterans, and friends of the office.

Sheriff Martin Cuellar and his wife, Donna Cuellar, personally handed out about 600 plates during the celebration. Laredo ER partnered with the Sheriff's Office to help make the luncheon possible.

“Thanksgiving reminds us that beyond our badges, titles, and responsibilities, we are one family united by a common purpose: serving our community with dedication, compassion, and heart,” Sheriff Cuellar said.

The Sheriff's Office announced the luncheon on its Facebook page Tuesday afternoon.
